description: Count how many contacts in an audience have an active push device (eligibleCount) versus the whole audience (audienceCount).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

includeTimingCoverage.description: Also return timingCoverage: eligible contacts, how many have a known timezone (local-time delivery), and how many have enough push clicks for their own optimal hour.

platforms.description: Limit delivery to these platforms. Omit (or pass []) to reach every platform the contact has a device on.

targetLists.description: Audience, same shape as campaign targetLists: {"type":"all"}, {"type":"lists","listIds":[...]}, {"type":"segment","segmentId":"..."}, or {"type":"rules","include":[...]}. Only contacts with an active push device receive the campaign.

name: estimate_push_campaign_recipients

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `estimate_push_campaign_recipients` MCP tool.

eligibleCount.description: Contacts with an active push device on the selected platforms.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
